name: Brand reveal: words punch in, panel folds into the logo
description: A full-frame orange panel where huge condensed words punch in one after another (black, then white), then the whole panel shrinks into a rounded orange square logo mark with a white icon on a clean background, and the brand name slides out beside it (the second part of the name in orange).
use_when: The moment the product or brand is named for the first time: 'that's why I built X', 'meet X', 'introducing', 'so we made X'.

words.help: 1-3 short words that punch in stacked (strings), usually the brand split in two, e.g. ['PUNCH', 'EDIT']; up to ~8 letters each

brand.help: wordmark shown beside the logo mark

split_at.help: characters of the brand shown in ink; the rest is orange (e.g. 5 for 'PUNCHEDIT'). Empty = colour the last word, or all ink for one word

icon.help: GFX icon name inside the logo mark, e.g. 'play', 'bolt', 'sparkle'
